garden-0-0: A butterfly left a tiny egg on a leaf. Shall we take a closer look? There is a little life growing inside. Let's be gentle and give it time.
garden-0-1: Zoey leans in. Did you see that tiny wiggle? The baby caterpillar is growing inside its egg.
garden-0-2: Crack! A little line appears in the shell. The caterpillar is ready to hatch. Watch the shell open.
garden-0-3: Hello, little caterpillar! It crawls out of its egg. Zoey waves hello. Our new friend is ready for some tasty leaves.
garden-1-0: Zoey picks a leaf. Our little caterpillar is hungry! Caterpillars eat leaves and shed their old skin as they grow.
garden-1-1: Crunch! Zoey offers the first leaf. What a lovely lunch. The caterpillar takes a bite and grows a little bigger.
garden-1-2: Crunch, crunch! Another leaf, another little growth spurt. Zoey reaches out carefully. Growing takes lots of energy.
garden-1-3: Our caterpillar is all grown. It finds a safe branch. Watch it hang in a J shape and shed its skin to reveal a chrysalis.
garden-2-0: A chrysalis hangs from the branch. Zoey waits quietly and watches. Inside, the caterpillar is changing into a butterfly.
garden-2-1: The garden is quiet. The chrysalis gently sways. Days pass in nature. Our little story makes time move faster.
garden-2-2: Look, Zoey! The chrysalis shell is beginning to split. A butterfly will emerge with soft, folded wings.
garden-2-3: The butterfly climbs out, slowly and carefully. It holds on while its soft wings begin to unfurl.
garden-3-0: Zoey watches the butterfly rest on the branch. Its wings are soft and folded. Give them time to expand.
garden-3-1: The wings slowly open. Look at those lovely colors! Zoey stretches too. The butterfly still needs time to dry its wings.
garden-3-2: The wings are open and dry. A new adventure is waiting. Zoey lifts a hand. Are you ready to help our friend take flight?
garden-3-3: Up, up, and away! Zoey waves as the butterfly takes flight. Tap a flower to invite it for nectar. A butterfly can lay eggs, and the story begins again.
zoo-intro: Welcome to the zoo! Follow the winding paths past every zone. Tap a friend to hear its name and see what it does. Let us meet thirty-four animal friends!
sea-intro: Come explore the ocean with me! Swim from the sunny surface down to the sandy seabed. Tap a friend and watch its own special way of moving. We can meet twenty-six ocean friends!
game-complete: You did it! Egg, caterpillar, chrysalis, butterfly. A wonderful circle of life!
zoey-hello: Hello! I am Zoey. Let us explore together!
nectar: A sweet little stop! The butterfly visits a flower for nectar.
lion: Here is the lion, king of the grassland! Listen to his big, deep voice.
elephant: Say hello to the elephant! She has a long trunk and big, flappy ears.
giraffe: The giraffe is the tallest animal of all. Her long neck reaches up to the treetops!
zebra: Stripes, stripes, stripes! This is the zebra, and no two zebras have the same stripes.
monkey: The monkey loves to climb and swing from tree to tree. Can you hear him chatter?
owl: Shh, it is the owl! She has big round eyes that can see in the dark.
tiger: Here comes the tiger! His orange and black stripes help him hide in the tall grass.
bear: Meet the bear! He is big and cuddly, and he loves to eat honey.
duck: Waddle, waddle! This is the duck, and she loves to splash in the pond.
frog: Splash! The frog sits by the pond, ready to take a great big hop.
hippo: The hippo has a very big mouth, and she loves a long, cool bath.
rhino: This is the rhino. He has a big, strong horn on his nose.
otter: The otter is a playful swimmer. She loves to dive, roll and slide.
panda: The panda munches bamboo all day long. Crunch, crunch, crunch!
kangaroo: Boing, boing! The kangaroo hops along, and her baby rides in her pouch.
penguin: The penguin cannot fly, but she can swim fast and slide on her tummy!
crocodile: Careful, this is the crocodile! He has a long mouth and lots of sharp teeth.
flamingo: The flamingo is pink, and she can stand on just one leg. Can you balance like her?
gorilla: The gorilla is big and strong. Do you see him pat his chest?
fox: The fox is clever, with pointy ears and a fluffy tail.
deer: The deer tiptoes through the forest on long, slim legs.
rabbit: Hop, hop, hop! The rabbit has long ears and a tiny twitchy nose.
horse: This is the horse. She can gallop fast, with her long tail flying behind.
cow: The cow gives us fresh milk. Can you hear her say moo?
orangutan: The orangutan has long orange hair, and very long arms for swinging in the trees.
polarbear: The polar bear lives where it is snowy and cold. Her thick white fur keeps her warm.
camel: The camel has a big hump on his back. It helps him walk far across the hot desert.
koala: The koala is soft and sleepy. She hugs a tree and munches on leaves.
sheep: Baa, baa! The sheep has a fluffy woolly coat that keeps her warm.
pig: Oink, oink! The pig has a curly tail, and she loves to roll in the mud.
peacock: Ta-da! The peacock spreads his beautiful tail like a giant fan.
tortoise: The tortoise is slow and steady. Her shell is her cozy home.
snake: The snake has no legs, so she slithers along the ground, nice and slow.
lemur: The lemur has a long tail with black and white rings. Look how high it goes!
turtle: The sea turtle paddles through the water with her big, strong flippers.
clownfish: Peek-a-boo! The clownfish hides among the soft, waving sea anemone.
dolphin: The dolphin is clever and playful. Watch her leap out of the waves!
octopus: The octopus has eight wiggly arms. Can you count them with me?
whale: The whale is the biggest animal in the sea. She sings a deep, slow song.
jellyfish: The jellyfish floats like a soft umbrella. She drifts gently, up and down.
shark: Here swims the shark, with a tall fin on his back. He is a fast swimmer.
stingray: The stingray glides along the sandy sea floor, like a flying carpet.
seahorse: The seahorse swims standing up straight. Her curly tail holds onto the seaweed.
crab: Click, click! The crab walks sideways on the sand and waves his claws.
seal: The seal has smooth fur and long whiskers. She loves to flip and splash.
pufferfish: The pufferfish puffs up like a round balloon when he is surprised!
starfish: The starfish has five arms. Let us count them: one, two, three, four, five!
manta: The manta ray flaps her wide wings, and flies through the water.
swordfish: The swordfish has a long pointy nose, and he swims super fast.
shrimp: The shrimp is small and pink. She flicks her tail and zooms backward!
lobster: The lobster has two big claws. Snap, snap, snap!
mermaid: The mermaid has a shiny green tail. She swims along with her fish friends.
bluetang: The blue tang is a bright blue fish with a sunny yellow tail. She loves the coral reef.
angelfish: The angelfish has long, flowing fins. She swims slowly, like a dancer.
orca: The orca is black and white. He swims with his family, in a group called a pod.
narwhal: The narwhal has one very long tusk. She is like a unicorn of the sea!
moray: The moray eel peeks out of her rocky home. Her mouth opens wide!
squid: The squid zooms through the water with a whoosh, using jet power.
hermitcrab: The hermit crab carries a shell on her back. It is her cozy, moving home.
seaotter: The sea otter floats on her back, and uses her tummy as a little table.
clock-intro: Welcome to my clock cottage! The long hand stays at twelve. Move the short hand to the hour we need.
clock-wrong: Almost! Keep the long hand at twelve. Let us try the short hand again.
clock-done: You did it! We found all the hours in our lovely day.
market-intro: Let us visit the little market! Follow our shopping list. Put the food in the basket. Then pay one gold coin for each item.
market-wrong: That is not on our list just now. Let us put it back and look again.
market-good: Lovely! Into our basket it goes!
market-pay: Our basket is ready! Put one gold coin for each piece on the tray. Then tap the big green tick.
market-coins: Let us count again. One gold coin for each piece of food.
market-done: Perfect! Thank you! Here is your shopping bag. See you again!
kitchen-intro: Welcome to my little kitchen! First look at our finished dish. Then follow the recipe, one ingredient at a time.
kitchen-wrong: Not yet, little chef! Let us look at the next ingredient and try again.
kitchen-stir: Now stir it around! Three little circles, nice and gentle.
kitchen-wait: Listen! Our soup is bubbling. Let us give it a little time.
kitchen-done: We made it! What a lovely dish. You are a wonderful little chef!
recipe-boat: A fruit boat! First the banana, then strawberries, then blueberries.
recipe-soup: Vegetable soup! Carrot, broccoli, tomato, and water. Then stir and wait for the bubbles.
recipe-milk: Strawberry milk! Strawberries first, then milk. Give it a little stir.
clock-8: It is eight in the morning. Let us have breakfast!
clock-find-8: Breakfast time! Can you move the short hand to eight?
clock-10: It is ten in the morning. Let us visit the little market!
clock-find-10: Market time! Can you move the short hand to ten?
clock-12: It is twelve, noon! Let us go to the garden!
clock-find-12: Garden time! Can you move the short hand to twelve?
clock-15: It is three in the afternoon, fifteen hundred hours. Let us watch the mermaid swim!
clock-find-15: Mermaid time! Can you move the short hand to three?
clock-16: It is four in the afternoon. Let us take a little rest.
clock-find-16: Rest time! Can you move the short hand to four?
clock-18: It is six in the evening. Let us cook some lovely soup!
clock-find-18: Soup time! Can you move the short hand to six?
clock-20: It is eight in the evening. Time for a warm bath!
clock-find-20: Bath time! Can you move the short hand to eight?
clock-21: It is nine in the evening, twenty-one hundred hours. Let us tell a princess story!
clock-find-21: Princess story time! Can you move the short hand to nine?
traffic-intro: Let us walk with a grown-up! Choose a turn. Wait for green, then walk together.
traffic-wait: Red means wait. The cars are moving. We stay on the pavement.
traffic-look: Green is here. Look right, left, and right again. Check that cars have stopped.
traffic-wrong: Wait with me. We can walk when it is green and the cars have stopped.
traffic-cross: The cars have stopped. Hold a grown-up’s hand, and walk together.
traffic-done: We arrived! What a lovely walk together!
counting-intro: A picnic for our animal friends! Give each friend the number of snacks on the card.
counting-wrong: Let us count again. Match the number on our picnic card.
counting-done: The numbers match! Our little friend is ready for a picnic.
letters-intro: Welcome to our letter post office! Match the letter, and deliver a little picture.
letters-wrong: Almost! Look at the letter on our envelope. Try another postbox.
letters-done: A lovely delivery! You found the matching letter.
seedling-intro: 来种一朵郁金香吧！先点一点小铲子，挖一个小坑，再放种子。
seedling-dig: 再点一点小铲子，继续挖。轻轻挖三下。
seedling-seed: 小坑准备好了！放进一颗种子。
seedling-cover: 现在盖上一点土。给小种子盖好被子。然后请大太阳来帮忙。
seedling-sun: 大太阳当空晒，一片叶子长出来。
seedling-wrong: 先等等，看看下一步要做什么。
seedling-done: 最后，开出花朵啦！你照顾得真好！一朵漂亮的郁金香送给你。
letter-c: This letter is C. C is for cow.
letter-g: This letter is G. G is for giraffe.
letter-i: I. Ice cream starts with I.
letter-w: This letter is W. W is for whale.
traffic-green: Green! The cars have stopped. Hold hands and walk together.
traffic-park: Let us visit the park. Which way shall we go?
traffic-market: Let us visit the market. Which way shall we go?
traffic-library: Let us visit the library. Which way shall we go?
traffic-next: Here is another crossing. Choose our next turn.
market-cashier: Hello! Welcome to our little market. Here is your picture shopping list.
market-checkout: The coins match! Tap the big green tick to give them to our cashier.
kitchen-next: Another little dish! Match the next picture and put it in our bowl.
play-tap: Tap the picture. Let us try it together!
seedling-worm: 小蚯蚓翻土快，两片叶子长出来。
seedling-rain: 毛毛雨来灌溉，三片叶子长出来。
seedling-grandpa: 老爷爷来耕耘，所有叶子长出来。
connect-intro: 给好朋友连一连线吧！拖一拖，或者先点一个，再点它的好朋友。
connect-wrong: 再找找看，谁是它的好朋友呢？
connect-giraffe-leaf: 长颈鹿伸长脖子吃树叶！
match-intro: 找到两个一样的，轻轻点一点，它们就会消除啦！
match-theme-vehicle: 找一找，一样的交通工具！
match-theme-sea: 找一找，一样的海洋朋友！
